summary: Docebo Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing an amended substantial issuer bid, increasing the repurchase price to US$25.00 per common share and extending the expiry to September 8, 2026. The maximum shares purchasable decreased to 2,800,000, with total offer value up to US$70,000,000. The offer is for cancellation, with terms unchanged otherwise. Shareholders with nominee-held shares must act promptly. The notice of variation will be distributed. Watch for proration levels and final tender results; risk-arb focuses on the spread between market price and offer price.
